transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 136 Stroudwater Lane?
Yeah, this is me at 136 Stroudwater Lane, just me here, no one else, water’s not in the house, and I’m totally fine—no need for any truck, boat, or extra seats, I’m good on my own.
How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me here, all by myself, no one else around, and I’m totally fine—no water in the house either, so no rush.
Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, just me, all good, no one here who can’t leave on their own, not even a wheelchair or oxygen—everything’s fine, no need for help.
Thanks for letting us know you're all set. Is there water inside the home right now?
Nope, no water inside at all, just me here, all good, no need for any help or trucks or boats—everything’s dry and fine.
Glad to hear everything’s dry and fine. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and I’m all alone—no seats to spare, sorry!
Understood, you’re alone with no truck or boat. Let me read that back: people at the home not confirmed; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just me here, no water in yet, and I’m not stuck or anything, just chillin’ at 136 Stroudwater Lane.
Thanks for confirming your situation is calm and clear. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
